hintTitle: Open the release page of Forkyard {{version}} in the browser

command.title: Check for updates…
command.keywords: update, updates, new version, release, upgrade

auto.title: Check for updates automatically
auto.description: Once a day, Forkyard asks GitHub (api.github.com) for the newest stable release. Only the app version is sent. A new version is shown in the status bar. Installing always needs your click.

dialog.title: Forkyard {{version}}
dialog.downloaded: Downloaded and checked. Forkyard restarts to finish.
dialog.failed: The update could not be installed

items: Rebase right in the graph: drag commits to reorder, squash or drop them, and see the result before it is applied.
Commit selected lines: draw a lasso over the lines you want and commit just those.
Review pull requests in the app, on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea and Azure DevOps.
A "since yesterday" overview shows what changed in your repositories while you were away.
The branch cleaner says why each branch can go: merged, gone upstream or stale.
Several windows, your own shortcuts and one-click updates.
